_help: vans = the configurations to compare; active = id of the van that is packed and shown. interior = [length, width, height] cm (minimum load space from the rental spec), payloadKg = rated payload (already includes a 75 kg driver), passengerKg = everyone else in the cab; subtracted from every van's payload unless subtractPassenger is false (then shown separately). door = rear door opening [width, height] cm. obstacles = wheel arches etc. with pos [x, y, z] and dims [L, W, H] cm.
_passenger: Michelle 67 kg (2026-10-15). Shown next to the payload, not subtracted: the rated payload assumes a 90 % full tank and we expect to drive with less (a Crafter tank is ~75 l, ~0.84 kg/l, so half a tank is ~25 kg lighter).
